CheckTitle: GuardDuty Detector with High severity findings
Description: GuardDuty Detector found having High and/or Critical severity findings.
Risk: Open High and Critical severity findings could lead to the compromise of sensitive data and services, unauthorized access and data tampering.

Recommendation.Text: Prioritize findings based on severity and address them according to recommendations. Set up alerts and continuously assess and handle findings based pre-defined timelines defined per severity, and according to business practices.
